subject: Craftprotz Kreativbierbar / TRVRS

entry.title: TRVRS Begins To Brew
entry.hook: The TRVRS story begins with barrel aging.

claims: The project began its first barrel-aging experiments in Trier in 2020 during the COVID-19 pandemic.
The project used the Craftprotz name at the time.
The TRVRS name was adopted in 2022, referring to Treveris.
Project beers have been served at Craftprotz Kreativbierbar, operated by project brewer Niko Weiler.
The project does not currently own a brewhouse and uses other breweries for production.
Its beers are served at Craftprotz.
Craftprotz serves its own TRVRS beers.
The official website links to instagram.com/craftprotz_kreativbierbar.
The current festival participant is Craftprotz Kreativbierbar, with its TRVRS beer brand.
The current festival heading gives 2–3 October 2026 at Blesius Garten, Trier.

copy.series_title: The Stories Behind the Trier Beer Festival 2026
copy.caption:
Craftprotz is a Trier beer institution for me. The people behind @craftprotz_kreativbierbar are very good friends, and it’s where #craftbeerszenetrier holds its regular Stammtisch. I’m delighted to feature the bar and its brewing project, TRVRS, in The Stories Behind the Trier Beer Festival 2026.

In 2020, during the pandemic, the project began barrel-aging experiments in Trier under the Craftprotz name. It adopted the name TRVRS in 2022, a reference to Treveris, the Latin name associated with Trier. The project’s beers are also served at Craftprotz.

Meet Craftprotz at the Trier Beer Festival on 2–3 October 2026 at Blesius Garten, Trier, hosted by @kraft_braeu_trier and @blesius_garten.

Explore “TRVRS Begins To Brew” on Beer Chronicles through the link in the accompanying Story.

Tickets are still available:
https://www.ticket-regional.de/events_info.php?eventID=275224
